_readme: The ARKLIST: hand-picked favourites, one list per sport. Each entry is "Name|Team" or just "Name" (any team). An entry can be anyone on that sport's boards, prospects included: college players, recruits in the 2027-29 classes (college-football) and internationals (college-basketball), and coaches (college-football: the staff board's head coaches and coordinators). nhl, soccer, hockey-prospects, soccer-prospects and cs2 match the NHL WAR board, the big-five player board the two prospect boards and the CS2 player board. Marked with the site glyph on the boards; each sport page has an ARKLIST tab and /arkboard/arklist/ shows them all together. college-football is also read by scripts/fetch_cfb.mjs for the star flag in the board data.
